label: PF Backlog 506
title: EPIC: Pipeline review quality - production-risk checklist for the code-review agent (LLM + corroboration + PR gate)
body:
## Problem / why
The code-review agent (Stage 5) is anti-SCAFFOLDING (checks pass/TODO/mocks/tests/plan-alignment) but NOT
anti-PRODUCTION-INCIDENT. It does not explicitly check business-logic correctness, security, injection
(SQL/command/template), performance (N+1), unhandled edge cases, or flag auth/payments/data-deletion risk - and
it can nitpick style. Reviews run per implementation ITERATION (a feature batch), and the PR gate
(core/pr_gate.py) already requires the review to be approved.

## Goal & value
Each build iteration's code is reviewed against a concrete PRODUCTION-RISK checklist (business logic, security,
injection, performance/N+1, edge cases), always flags auth/payments/deletion, ignores style, and BLOCKS on
critical issues - so the reviewer catches what breaks in production, not just scaffolding.

## Children
E1 code-review card checklist; E2 config/review-focus.json (shared checklist); E3 static corroboration +
critical-block; E4 review-model docs.
